title: Nazi flying saucers attempted but not achieved

plain: The Nazis tried to build flying saucers but never had the technology to pull it off. That is the view of Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, who tells Michels so without naming a source. He grants that there were wartime experiments and reports of "foo fighters", the glowing balls of light Allied pilots described over Bavaria, but he says that "in reality they did not have the technology," which would mean the saucer stories do not lead back to Germany.
